title: I cried the first time. I cried even harder the second. a perfect mus...
transcript: that was the craziest thing I've ever seen in my entire life so good I am on day three of a six day theater trip to London I'm seeing a lot of shows and I still don't have time to see all the shows I want to see but today I'm using a valuable precious spot to see a show I have already seen and that's because I thought about this show non stop for months it's The Curious Case of Benjamin Button I saw Benjamin Button back in February and it is the best show I have seen in 2025 cast recording came out a few months ago I've listened to it like every single day and I cannot believe I'm back show is closing in October and I literally moved my flight so I could add this slot so I could see it I love this set I love this theatre I did buy a program which I don't normally do but I wanted the program for this since it's closing and I cry that it's everyone's baby pictures why is this the cutest playbill of all time ever I'm so excited to be back turns out I love it even more on the second viewing The Curious Case of Benjamin Button is storytelling  at its finest a true ensemble cast working together to tell this story each and every night it is heartbreaking and beautiful and hilarious and I want every single person to see it if you're in London between now and October 11th I am devastated it's closing but I would love to see a transfer to literally anywhere in the states and I also feel like regional theatres and high schools and colleges are going to do real exceptional productions of it but you actually do have to see this cast so go go go if you can
showTitle: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
classificationReason: Creator attended this London production twice and gives detailed first-hand opinion ('best show I have seen in 2025', 'heartbreaking and beautiful and hilarious'), but this show is not on the provided list
